LONDON CORN MARKET, AUG. 12.
The rates obtained for Euglish wheat were equal to last Mon¬
day's prices, but millers evice little desire to operate, but the
supply is limited. Foreign held for full prices, but sales limited.
Oats attracted little atteution, but inferior rather lower. Flour
trade quiet at last Monday's rates. Barley fetched fill terms, and
but little done. In the value of beans no change, and trade quiet.
For Indian corn the demand slow. English white wheat, 43s, to
50s.; red, 41s. to 45s.
ARRIVALS.— British— Wheat, 3,320; barley, 34; oats, 229; malt,
6,123; flour, 8,405. Irish-Malt, 46. Foreign-Wheat, 23,625;
barley, 7,673; oats, 26,001 ; flour, 6,920 sacks, 30 barrels.
SECOND REPORT.—No particular change since this morning.
Little done in British or foreign wheat, or other articles. There
was heavy rain, with thander; but there are symptoms of change.
